changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientobservationscomplaints AS SELECT poc.id, poc.patient_id, poc.encounter_id, poc.functional_status, poc.patient_conditions, poc.reason_of_visit, poc.cognitive_check, poc.is_active, poc.created_by, poc.created_date, poc.last_modified_by, poc.last_modified_date, poc.blood_group, poc.by_patient, poc.source_of_information, poc.mode_of_arrival FROM public.patient_observations_complaints poc;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientobservationscomplaints TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientobservationscomplaints FROM report_user;
